arcs.title: Above Marker 9
arcs.summary: Day 2: Ashworth's sketch arrived by owl — burnt-sienna ink, spare and exact. It shows the spur's climbing line with three gradient marks, a notation reading 'shelf?' at the hundred-yard limit, and an unlabelled circle above that. Steve confirmed the spur's mouth on a Sunday drive: a real gap in the treeline, uneven ground, long-unrun. Christine has identified the sketch as an invitation, not a question. The expedition file is open; Day 3 should establish a run date, perhaps a first attempt to drive the mouth or scout the shelf — or a second communication from Ashworth with more detail about the unlabelled circle, which neither Steve nor Christine has yet asked her about directly.
